title: Targeting the ferritinophagy-lysosome axis as a therapeutic vulnerability in gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors.
model: BON-1 pancreatic NET, Brunello kinome KO (two half-pools)
contrast: Day 14 vs day 0 per half-pool (1 vs 1)
paper_method: Mean guide fold change, libraries A and B integrated
paper_calls: 44 genes at fold change < -0.3; ILK, PTK2, PIKFYVE, PIK3C3 highlighted
barcs_calls: Pool A: 47 genes at FDR 0.10 (29 depleted); pool B: 36 (30 depleted)
named_hits: 4/4 depleted at FDR 0.10 in pool A (PTK2 #1, ILK #2, PIK3C3 #16, PIKFYVE #26 among depleted genes, by p); 3/4 in pool B
verdict: BARCS agrees: PTK2, ILK, PIK3C3 and PIKFYVE are significant depletions in half-pool A, ILK and PIKFYVE also in half-pool B, and the top of the ranking matches the paper's (Spearman 0.69). One library per time point, so the FDR is screening-level without replicate variance.
